caseSelection: First two displayed ballots; distinct from original five development ballots. No case substitution.
editorial: All the Beauty and the Bloodshed
protocol: Resolve unique exact-title seeds (ambiguities abstain); sequential same-seed queries at 12 and 20; exclude seed IDs and normalized titles; keep provider order, legacy and conservative rerank. Independently retrieved editorial top12 removes identical seed titles and requires no Qloo calls. Freeze rankings before matching held-out normalized titles. All 10 held-outs remain in denominators; no post-result tuning.
limits: Tiny retrospective expert convenience sample; absence is not dislike; exact title is provisional, no year/director proof.
Editorial baseline uses the same poll's aggregate, including evaluated voters: circularity benefits baseline. It is not an independent generalization comparison.
Editorial baseline is restricted to annual films; Qloo is unrestricted, a domain mismatch. This tests discovery overlap, not ordinary-user relevance.
Answer is simulated, not a statement by either voter; no genuine question-efficiency or correction-recovery measure.
Provider descriptions are inspected in memory only; persist title/ID/year, metadata presence, hint support/order, latency and call counts. No identity or held-out titles sent to Qloo.
